observations: Three photos show multiple mini perfume sprayers with marble-like patterns and gold accents.
Photo 0: Three pink and gold marble-patterned sprayers, one with a cutout window. A hand holds a small spray nozzle over a round glass perfume bottle.
Photo 1: Three white and gold marble-patterned sprayers, same design as photo 0, with the same hand and bottle.
Photo 2: Three sprayers in pastel purple, lavender, and blue with floral designs and gold accents.
All sprayers are cylindrical, two-part (cap and body), with a silver metal band at the joint.
The nozzle is small, white, and appears to be made of plastic or silicone.
The round glass bottle in the left of each photo is not part of the sprayer set; it is a separate item shown for context.
Watermark 'RHEMEX GLOBAL ENTERPRISES' is visible on all photos.
No visible brand or model name on the sprayers themselves.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a mini perfume sprayer by type. Hidden risks like leakage or material quality are noted, but do not prevent pricing.
